method: Piecewise annual history separating Czechoslovak-era Slovak tennis context from the independent Slovak federation era, with temporally gated competition, NTC and active-athlete evidence.
evidence_rules: Pre-1993 ratings describe Slovak tennis within Czechoslovakia, not an independent Slovak national system.
1990 STZ registration is institutional continuity; 1993 international membership marks the independent-era system.
Active-athlete counts are federation-defined and are not total casual participation.
The first Challenger and national leagues inform competition opportunity; elite player results are not direct country-quality inputs.
NTC team evidence informs development/support only from 2000.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
